notes: All model/hyperparameter/threshold choices use only grouped inner out-of-fold predictions from the corresponding outer training data.
Selection for all five seeds is saved and frozen before any new outer-test score is computed.
OOF scores are optimized model-selection scores, not unbiased final performance estimates.
Outer development splits were previously inspected; this is a paired development comparison, not a fresh hidden test.
The new hybrid adds a supervised head and sentence-context features. It is an extension of the original frozen rank-fusion system and uses additional label-driven fitting.
The context-only and retrieval-only controls receive the same nested selection and threshold-calibration procedure.
Full candidate scores replace the top-100 truncation during classification. Frozen encoders and the reference BM25 corpus remain unchanged.
Exact-text grouping blocks exact duplicate leakage; source/near-duplicate and future-language generalization are not established.
